source.title: Historic Environment Record Monuments (poly), MapServer layer 2 exact MonUID query
source.license: Not stated in selected ArcGIS layer metadata/query window

evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official HER polygon layer 2 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer and exposes MonUID, RecordType, Name, MonType, Summary, Period, Validation and SHAPE on the same feature schema. A single-record public no-login query for MonUID MDV105844 was attempted with returnGeometry=true, but the exact query payload was inaccessible before any feature attributes or polygon coordinates were read. Accordingly no record-level physical footprint or bound HOUSE/HOTEL type-use evidence was accepted.

field_evidence.footprint: Official DCC HER layer 2 is esriGeometryPolygon and SHAPE is on the feature schema; exact MDV105844 geometry payload was not retrievable.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer 2 exposes MonType on the same feature schema; exact MDV105844 MonType value was not retrievable.
field_evidence.identity: Exact query targets MonUID MDV105844 and requests Name, but the feature payload was not retrievable.
